title: ThreatWeaveEvent
description: Canonical Event Schema for ThreatWeave security log normalization and correlation

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the event (e.g. evt-001)

event_type.description: Normalized category: login_success, login_failure, file_access, usb_connected, usb_copy, outbound_connection, process_start, etc.

source.description: Log source origin: windows, linux, vpn, firewall, edr, file_server, etc.

action.description: Observed action: read, write, execute, connect, mount, authenticate

device_id.description: Endpoint hostname or device ID (e.g. device-17, WKST-9102)

application.description: Process name or application (e.g. FileExplorer, powershell.exe, curl.exe)

resource.description: Target file path, share name, or URI

attributes.description: Arbitrary contextual key-value attributes (e.g. bytes, login_location, device_trust, removable_media_id)

raw.description: Original raw event payload prior to normalization
